goodToKnow: Der Freistaat is a free state, originally a German word for republic, as opposed to a monarchy. Today three German Länder use it in their official names: der Freistaat Bayern, der Freistaat Sachsen and der Freistaat Thüringen. It gives them no extra legal rights, but it expresses regional pride, especially in Bavaria. The city-states Hamburg and Bremen call themselves Freie und Hansestadt. Plural: die Freistaaten.
